principle_violations.reason: The payment processor classes are responsible for both payment processing and status management of the order, which is a separate concern.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of order status management from the payment processing. Use a separate class for handling order status or events.

principle_violations.reason: The DebitCardPaymentProcessor class uses a specific authentication mechanism (SMSAuthorizer), which can lead to issues when substituted with another payment processor that does not use SMS authorization.
principle_violations.suggestion: Make sure all payment processors either rely on a common authentication strategy or define their own without disrupting the main structure.

suggestion_code: this.authorizer.authenticate(); // Ensure every payment processor has a standard authenticate method.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
